title: 28章：天下第八妖祸出
content_zh:
张荼就坐在那里，清澈的大眼睛里带着点茫然。

    正是因为边关月的一句话，“那日，你所斩杀的那个野猪，很不幸，蕴含着一丝麒麟血。”

    有诗云：“麒麟踏祥云，人间百难消。”那丑陋不堪的野猪，竟是蕴含了一丝麒麟血脉，着实有点崩碎张荼对于麒麟等神兽的幻想。

    看到张荼的茫然和不解，边关月悠然说道：“天地五灵，麒麟，青龙，白虎，朱雀，玄武，对应五行，土，木，金，火，水。”

    “虽有天生五灵，但天道轮回，并未断绝所有晋升之路，亦是给予了万灵得以进境的可能，若是因天赐，是有机会由后天生灵不断进化为传说之中的先天之属。”

    “而那孽畜，则是在天地大变之中，得到一丝神佑，天赐激活了不属于它的血脉，而又丧命你手……是它的劫难，也是你的造化。”

    张荼幽幽道来：“这不就是人人成龙嘛？可是这跟我有什么关系？对了，断它天赐，会有什么影响么？”

    正所谓，曾有大贤希望这世间，再无压迫束缚，凡生于世，都能有活着的权力，有自由的权利，亦有幸福的权力。愿终有一日人人生而平等，在无贵贱之分，守护生命，追求光明……生而平等，人人成龙。

    这终归是一种美好的梦幻吧，可是在无情的天道面前，却是蕴含着人人如龙的希望，这如何不让张荼对这天道既敬且畏。

    而如今，张荼所拥有的一切，称之为天赐，也自无不可。

    边关月悠然道：“物竞天择，乃是造化之道，懂么？”

    “问题自然就是出在这里，原本升级，不过是慢慢进阶，夯实基础，直到第五次晋级的时候，才会圆满五行，可是你第一次所献祭，便是蕴含着麒麟真血……”

    顿了顿，边关月才继续说道，其实他的内心也是懵逼的，我随手指的练手之物，竟是蕴含着麒麟血的神物，暴殄天物啊。

    “也正是因为你第一次献祭的是蕴含着麒麟真血，且中麒麟之说你可曾听过？五行之中的土属又有根基一说，这才给了你连蹦四级的可能。”

    听这边关月的诉说，张荼大概知道了什么原因，换成游戏的说法就是，完成了隐藏的面板潜藏任务呗，这个张荼理解，毕竟自己拿到了bug，有点加成也是理解的。

    可是借贷是什么鬼？

    这个才是张荼所在意的。

    可是这个魂淡啊，从头到尾都不提这个。

    张荼无奈开口道：“这些叫事儿么？我是问你借贷什么鬼？王城升级已经够离谱的了，你还给我搞一个借贷系统？资本的力量？达瓦里氏的燎原烈火在哪里！”

    看着有些气急败坏的张荼，边关月有些好笑，当真是一朝被蛇咬十年怕井绳，如今的他，尤其是那些所谓的黑暗森林可以禁锢的？

    “你莫慌，我说的借贷，和你所知的借贷，并不一样。”边关月的声音悠悠，平缓而安定：“我说的借贷，是以麒麟血为根基，以第八纪元为引子，强行为你凝聚王城五行之根基，但这属于逆天而行，若是不成，终归是如同青春里一段凛冽刻骨的浮光掠影罢了，但若是你能够在有效时间内彻底锻造而成，那绝对可以让你****。”
content_en:
Zhang Tu was sitting there, with a bit of confusion in his big clear eyes.

It was precisely because of Bian Guanyue's words, "Unfortunately, the wild boar you killed that day contained a trace of unicorn blood."

There is a poem that goes: "The Qilin steps on the auspicious clouds, causing all the troubles in the world." That ugly wild boar actually contains a trace of Qilin blood, which really shatters Zhang Tu's fantasy about Qilin and other mythical beasts.

Seeing Zhang Tu's confusion and confusion, Bian Guanyue said leisurely: "The five spirits of heaven and earth, Qilin, Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu, correspond to the five elements, earth, wood, gold, fire, and water."

"Although there are five innate spirits, the reincarnation of heaven does not cut off all paths of advancement. It also gives all spirits the possibility to enter. If it is a gift from heaven, there is a chance to evolve from acquired spirits to the legendary innate attributes."

"And that evil beast received a little blessing from the gods during the great changes in the world. God's gift activated a bloodline that did not belong to it, and it died at your hands... It was its disaster, and it was also your fate."

Zhang Tu said quietly: "Isn't this the idea that everyone can become a dragon? But what does this have to do with me? By the way, will it have any impact if it is cut off from God's gift?"

As the saying goes, there was a great sage who hoped that there would be no more oppression and restraint in this world, and that everyone who was born in this world would have the right to live, the right to freedom, and the right to happiness.I hope that one day all people are born equal, no distinction between high and low, protect life, pursue light... Born equal, everyone will become a dragon.

This is a beautiful dream after all, but in the face of the ruthless Heaven, it contains the hope that everyone is like a dragon. How can this not make Zhang Tu respect and fear the Heaven.

But now, everything Zhang Tu has can be called a gift from heaven.

Bian Guanyue said leisurely: "Natural selection is the way of creation, do you understand?"

"The problem naturally arises here. The original upgrade was just to advance slowly and solidify the foundation. It will not be until the fifth promotion that the five elements will be perfected. However, the sacrifice you made for the first time contained the true blood of Kirin..."

After a pause, Bian Guanyue continued. In fact, he was also confused in his heart. The training object I pointed at was actually a divine object containing unicorn blood. What a waste of nature.

"It is precisely because your first sacrifice contains the true blood of Qilin, and have you ever heard of the theory of Qilin? The earth attribute among the five elements has a foundation, which gives you the possibility to jump to the fourth level in a row."

Listening to what Guan Yue said here, Zhang Tu probably knew the reason. In game terms, it was that he had completed the hidden task of hiding on the panel. Zhang Tu understood this. After all, he got the bug, so he understood the bonus.

But what the hell is a loan?

This is what Zhang Tu cares about.

But this soul is dull, and this is not mentioned from beginning to end.

Zhang Tu said helplessly: "Is this a big deal? What the hell am I asking you about borrowing? The upgrade of the royal city is outrageous enough, and you still want to create a loan system for me? The power of capital? Where is the prairie fire of the Davari clan!"

Looking at Zhang Tu who was a little angry, Bian Guanyue was a little amused. Is it true that he was once bitten by a snake and was afraid of well ropes for ten years? Now he, especially those in the so-called dark forest, can be imprisoned?

"Don't panic, the loan I'm talking about is different from the loan you know." Bian Guanyue's voice was long, gentle and stable: "The loan I'm talking about is based on the blood of Qilin, using the eighth era as the introduction, to forcibly gather the royal city for youThe foundation of the Five Elements, but this is against the will of heaven.If it fails, it will be like a harsh glimpse of youth, but if you can completely forge it within the effective time, it will definitely make you ****."
